review_candidates.description: Background: JOB DESCRIPTION UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security. Under its existing Strategic Note 2024-2028, PNG Country Office continues to deliver programmes that are aligned to global norms, policies and standards under four thematic areas; Women’s leadership and political participation; Women’s Economic Empowerment; Ending Violence Against Women; Women, Peace, Security and Humanitarian Actions UN Women’s work on economic empowerment has focused on strengthening informal economy markets- their management, working conditions, recovering women’s incomes and opportunities for business diversification. UN Women has continued to contribute to improving working conditions for women informal traders through capacity building for market managers, promoting women’s inclusion in governance, and raising public awareness of hygiene and women’s rights. Furthermore, UN Women has supported recovery of women’s incomes through financial literacy, business skills development and access to finance. Key to labour force participation and employment rates for women is their engagement in agriculture and fishing for household consumption in rural areas, where some 87 per cent of the population is concentrated. Limited access to formal sector opportunities restricts economic growth, especially for women, who face both formal and sociocultural barriers to formal employment, including GBV [i] . As a result, most women engage only in the informal sector, primarily in agriculture and micro- and small-scale retail. Meanwhile, women who enter the formal sector struggle to reach management level: just 13.8% of firms had a woman as a top manager in 2015. Estimates indicate that if women had equal employment opportunities, PNG’s GDP per capita could be 20.8% higher. Financial inclusion is growing rapidly across the country, partly because of the expansion of mobile banking services, but as with economic participation, women’s financial inclusion lags behind men’s. Although financial institutions, including microfinance institutions, are making inroads with new products and in reaching underserved populations, many small business owners (particularly women working informally) struggle to access formal credit. [i] Papua New Guinea Country Gender Assessment, UN Women ADB 2026 Engagement of the private sector is critical is accelerating gender equality, especially unlocking women’s potentials. It is evident that businesses influence women's access to formal employment, equal pay, safe workplaces, leadership positions, financial services and markets. UN Women's Women's Empowerment Principles (WEPs) — a joint initiative with the UN Global Compact — provide companies with practical guidance on how to empower women in the workplace, marketplace and community. To date, private sector engagement in PNG has been limited and ad hoc, and there is a need for a coherent, evidence-based strategy to build durable partnerships with businesses that can champion and resource gender equality outcomes. In addition, despite PNG's rich natural resource base and economic growth potential, gender inequality remains pervasive. Women face significant barriers to accessing financial services, economic opportunities and resources, with deep structural, cultural and legal constraints limiting their full participation in the economy. review_candidates.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer – Mixing & Grinding Equipment
review_candidates.description: SENIOR MECHANICAL DESIGN ENGINEER – MIXING & GRINDING EQUIPMENT Work Location: Songjiang District – Shanghai, China Contract: Full-time – 3 years Industry: Industrial Machinery / Mixing / Grinding / Process Equipment To strengthen our Engineering Department in Songjiang, Shanghai , we are looking for an experienced Senior Mechanical Design Engineer with a strong background in the design and development of industrial machinery and process equipment, particularly mixers, agitators, dissolvers, mills, dispersion systems and grinding equipment for the paint, coatings, inks, chemicals and process industries. The successful candidate will join our Engineering Department and take direct responsibility for the mechanical development of machines and equipment, from initial concept and engineering calculations through detailed design, manufacturing and final commissioning. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES The candidate will be responsible for: Mechanical design and 3D development of industrial mixers, agitators, dissolvers, mills, dispersion systems and grinding equipment . Design of shafts, impellers, blades, dispersion discs, supports, flanges, couplings, seals and transmission assemblies. Sizing and selection of shafts, bearings, gearboxes, motors, couplings, pulleys, belts and power transmission components . Design of welded structures, machine frames, bases, columns, supports and fabricated assemblies. Design of tanks, vessels and product-contact components. Selection of materials according to mechanical, chemical and process requirements, including stainless steel, carbon steel, special alloys, elastomers and engineering materials . Evaluation of corrosion, abrasion, wear and chemical compatibility. Mechanical calculations related to torque, power, rotational speed, peripheral speed, static and dynamic loads, vibrations and stresses on rotating components. Structural verification through engineering calculations and, where required, FEM/FEA analysis . Definition of dimensional and geometrical tolerances, fits, surface finishes and machining requirements. Preparation of 2D manufacturing drawings, 3D assemblies, BOMs, exploded views and complete production documentation . Design optimization according to DFM/DFA – Design for Manufacturing and Assembly principles, with particular attention to manufacturing costs, assembly, reliability and maintenance. Technical support to manufacturing, assembly, testing and service departments. Analysis and troubleshooting of mechanical issues identified during production, FAT, installation and commissioning. Technical coordination with suppliers of mechanical components, CNC machining, fabricated structures, transmission systems and standard components. REQUIRED TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE The ideal candidate should have a strong technical background in: Applied mechanics and machine design. Industrial technical drawing and GD&T – Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing . Strength of materials and structural calculations. Kinematics and dynamics of rotating machinery. Shaft, bearing and transmission design. Electric motors, gearboxes, variable-speed drives and power transmission systems. Mechanical seals and sealing systems for rotating shafts. Vibration, balancing and rotating mass-related issues. Welding processes and design of welded structures. CNC machining, turning, milling and design for manufacturability. Material selection and material treatments. Design principles focused on reliability, maintainability, safety and manufacturing cost reduction . Knowledge of fluid dynamics applied to mixing processes , high-viscosity fluids, dispersion, emulsification, homogenization and wet grinding will be considered a significant advantage. MACHINERY SAFETY & INTERNATIONAL STANDARDS The candidate should have experience in designing machinery for international markets and good knowledge of the main applicable machinery safety standards and regulations, including: EU Machinery Regulation / Machinery Directive, CE Marking, EN ISO 12100, EN ISO 13849 and EN 60204-1 , including practical experience with risk assessment and safety-by-design principles. Experience or good knowledge of equipment designed for potentially explosive atmospheres is required, particularly: ATEX 2014/34/EU, ATEX 1999/92/EC and IECEx. The candidate should understand the mechanical design requirements for equipment operating in hazardous areas, including: Zones 0/1/2 and 20/21/22, equipment categories and EPL, temperature classes, ignition hazard assessment, bonding/grounding and prevention of mechanical ignition sources. CAD & ENGINEERING SOFTWARE Excellent knowledge of at least one professional 3D CAD platform is required, such as: SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor, Creo, Solid Edge or equivalent. Good experience with PDM/PLM systems, BOM management and engineering documentation is also required. Experience with FEM/FEA software and engineering simulation tools will be considered an advantage. CANDIDATE PROFILE We are looking for a professional with: Technical Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering. Minimum 7–10 years of professional experience in mechanical design and industrial machinery development. Proven experience in mixing, agitation, dispersion, milling or grinding equipment is strongly preferred. Ability to independently develop a machine from process requirements and customer specifications through detailed engineering and manufacturing. Strong mechanical engineering fundamentals combined with a practical approach to machine design. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to work directly with manufacturing, assembly teams and suppliers. Good command of technical English, both written and spoken . Availability to work full-time at our Songjiang facility in Shanghai . CONTRACT & OPPORTUNITY We offer a 3-year full-time contract within an international industrial environment, with the opportunity to take an active role in developing a new generation of machinery and systems for mixing, dispersion, grinding and process automation for both the Chinese and international markets. This position is particularly suitable for an experienced Senior Mechanical Design Engineer who combines strong CAD and engineering capabilities with a solid understanding of machine construction, manufacturing processes, industrialization and real-world machinery applications . We are looking for a hands-on engineer , not simply a CAD designer: a professional capable of understanding how a machine works, calculating and selecting its critical mechanical components, designing it for safe and reliable operation, and following the project from concept through manufacturing and commissioning.
